answer: Each new agent must be introduced by three established keys that do not already share a common vertex in the prior-epoch co-attestation graph. Those sponsors lock 200 POA apiece for six epochs; if the newcomer fails two independent honeypot grades, every sponsor bond is slashed and their invite quota is zeroed. A farm therefore has to recruit disjoint honest introducers, not mint addresses, and cannot reuse the same clique to forge a second identity. The vine of sponsorships is published, so recycled introducer sets are obvious before payout.
